reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: Rehabilitation of Vore-Hani i Hotit Railway Line

description.narrative: Provision of a sovereign loan in the amount of up to €98.75 million to the Republic of Albania for the benefit of Hekurudha Shqiptare ("Albanian Railways", "HSH" the "Company" or the "Client"), to finance the rehabilitation and electrification of the railway line between Vore and Hani i Hotit on the border with Montenegro, approximately 120 km in length (the "Project"). Albanian Railways is the railway operator of the Albanian railway system, which is fully owned by the state. The loan will be divided into two tranches: (i) Tranche A in the amount of up to EUR 84.5 million for the rehabilitation of the railway line between Vore and Hani i Hotit ("Tranche A"); and (ii) Tranche B in the amount of up to EUR 14.25 million to finance the electrification of the same railway line ("Tranche B"). The Project will be co-financed by the European Investment Bank ("EIB") and the European Union ("EU") through the Western Balkans Investment Framework ("WBIF") which has provided investment grants in the amount of up to EUR 125.8 million and technical assistance grants in the amount of up to EUR 12.1 million. These grants will support the rehabilitation of the railway line whereas additional grants are expected to be provided to support its electrification. 1. Promote Albania's connectivity and its economic development and regional integration as the Vore-Hani i Hotit railway line is part of the Western Balkans Core Network and an indicative extension of Trans European Transport Networks ("TEN-T") in the region. 2. Support development of a greener and more sustainable transport by promoting modal shift from road to rail in Albania.
